responsibility: This implementation module bridges DynamicStrings to libc getenv and putenv. It converts an input String to a C string for lookup or update, returns a newly allocated String for a found environment value, and handles NIL gracefully when no variable exists, making it the managed-string wrapper around the lower-level Environment module.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation side of the SEnvironment pair: unlike SEnvironment.def, it bridges DynamicStrings to libc by converting String values to C strings for getenv/putenv and creating returned String values from environment results.
